data.body: Additional diagnostic: ticket transition DOES recognize the Jira-style ID — it correctly reports the current status. Only ticket show (and likely ticket list/exists) fail to recognize it. Run: '.claude/scripts/dso ticket transition jira-dig-2529 in_progress closed' returns 'Error: current status is "closed", not "in_progress"' — proving (a) the ticket exists locally, (b) it's already closed, (c) transition can find it. The bug is scoped to the show/list lookup path, not the transition or update path.
